description: Returns per-item forensic analysis results including overall_grade (A–F; the Authenticity grade — edited, generated or re-encoded), exposure_grade (A–F; what the file gives away — privacy and hidden data), face_count, text_region_count, watermark_flagged (the known-generator decode only) and watermark_state (the one watermark verdict: found, declared, unconfirmed, unusual, not_checked, partial or none; none only when every watermark check ran and found nothing). Returns job_uid which can be passed to snapwonders_analyse_result for the clean summary. Requires X-Api-Key header.
name: snapwonders_analyse_job_results
